verdict: Organic traffic is holding; paid campaigns and key milestones need immediate attention.
narrative: This period, your paid advertising ran at zero spend across both Meta and Google, meaning no revenue engine was active for the full 28 days. Your Google Business Profile delivered 535 actions — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — showing that organic presence is still working, though profile engagement dipped in the most recent 7 days. Five planned milestones are currently overdue, including the Live-Cooking Shoot that was due August 14th, which is holding back the creative needed to restart ads. We are moving to clear the outstanding milestones this week so that paid campaigns and the creative pipeline can get back on track. Once those gates are cleared, ad ramp-up can begin and you should see spend and conversion data return in the next reporting period.
